dashboard.label: TA-journald-logplane Metrics
dashboard.description: Index-time metrics over index=metrics (sourcetype journald:metrics); series prefixed 'journald.'.

search.query: | mstats avg("journald.size_mb") as value where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename value as "journald.size_mb"
| mstats avg("journald.file_count") as value where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename value as "journald.file_count"
| mstats avg("journald.oldest_age_hours") as value where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename value as "journald.oldest_age_hours"
| mstats avg("journald.service_active") as value where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename value as "journald.service_active"
